feeds.title: Elements for Life Blog » Recipes
feeds.description: Elements for Life is the producer of award-winning Raw Chocolate Goodies for anyone who loves the great taste. A collection of simple recipes for making your own raw chocolate creations from our 30 min no-fail raw chocolate recipe through to raw vegan cakes.

feeds.title: Radek's Chocolate Blog
feeds.description: Organic, Vegan, Refined Sugar-Free, Radek's Chocolate is a Bristol-based artisan chocolate company. Inspired by Radek's passion for travel and love of the planet, Radek's Chocolate has always strived to source high-quality ingredients. They are fair trade, organic where possible and we always buy from trusted suppliers. Radek's Chocolate is officially organic and certified by OF&G.

feeds.title: Gnaw Chocolate Blog
feeds.description: Our vegan-friendly, single-origin, plant-based dreamy oat milk chocolate bars are wrapped in plastic-free home compostable packaging and produced in the UK. As a brand inspired by squirrels and their love of the great outdoors, we strive to do all we can to be sustainable, and planet conscious as well as handcrafting simply scrummy chocolate for you to enjoy that doesn't cost the earth.

feeds.title: Chocolate Fayre Blog
feeds.description: We are husband and wife team Kenny Walker and Sarah Wall and we simply love spreading happiness with chocolate! For over 30 years, Chocolate Fayre has provided the good people of Teesdale with the finest chocolates, sourced from some incredibly talented chocolatiers, as well as fabulously creamy ice cream, made from double Jersey cream just across the border in Cumbria by English Lakes Ice Cream.

feeds.title: Choc Affair Blog
feeds.description: We have been making Chocolate by Hand Since 2006. For us, making chocolate is a family affair, and hand-crafting is the only way we do things. Cocoa Corner has it all if you want to find out more about us or get copies of chocolate recipes. Read our blog to discover more about the world of chocolate.

feeds.title: The Chocolate Detective Blog
feeds.description: The finest chocolate uncovered by Chantal Coady

feeds.title: Chocolate Dino Company Blog
feeds.description: Chocolate Dino Company was born during the first lockdown in May 2020. Two hospitality professionals with over 30 years of experience between them decided to bring to the British public premium chocolate treats. To begin with, the business operated as an online retailer only, and with time event focused operation was added. We are best known at the events as a brand baking fresh cookies so they can be enjoyed straight from the oven.

feeds.title: Chocolatier.co.uk Blog
feeds.description: The Chocolatier UK Chocolate Blog Is A Chocoholics Paradise With Chocolate News, Reviews, Shopping, Travel, Recipes, And Interviews With Top Chocolatiers.

feeds.title: The Chocolate Society Blog
feeds.description: View our range of blogs on everything chocolate related! Find out what we have in store as well as what's in our box of the month.

feeds.title: Lucocoa Chocolate Blog
feeds.description: Hey! I'm Amarachi Clarke, founder of Lucocoa, London's first Bean to Bar Chocolate Maker. At Lucocoa, we make our chocolate by hand, from scratch, by importing the best beans from around the world and turning them into chocolate in our factory in Bermondsey, Southeast London.

feeds.title: Love Cocoa
feeds.description: Inspired by my great-great-great grandfather John Cadbury, I created Love Cocoa with the purpose of making great-tasting chocolate bars here in Great Britain. Our mission is to make chocolate consumption more sustainable. Read the blog and news section of Love Cocoa if you want to know the latest chocolate featuring recipes, chocolate news, and gift ideas.

feeds.title: Harrogate Chocolate Factory Blog
feeds.description: The Harrogate Chocolate Factory is a social enterprise aiming to help young people with learning disabilities and autism get the skills they need to help them into paid employment - and help everyone else feel good. Our chocolate contains cacao from the purest Peruvian Criollo bean which we slow roast at a low temperature to keep as many of the nutrients and antioxidants in our bars.

feeds.title: Rococo Chocolates Blog
feeds.description: At Rococo Chocolates we have been making British chocolate for over thirty-five years. Our rich heritage and expertise have enabled us to bring tastes and experiences to our customers for the first time. Get the latest news and information in regards to luxury handmade chocolate and the chocolate world by checking out our blog at Rococo Chocolates.

feeds.title: Rowdy & Fancy's Chocolate Blog
feeds.description: Welcome To Rowdy And Fancy's Chocolate. Especially tempting artisan chocolate made in the Sussex countryside. We're passionate about high-quality ingredients, unique and delicious flavors - and keeping our planet green. We hand-temper and hand-wrap our chocolate bars in our workshop in East Sussex.

feeds.title: Montezuma's Blog
feeds.description: We started Montezuma's, our little chocolate business, in 2000 with only a kitchen sink-sized machine, huge enthusiasm, spades of naivety, and most importantly, a broad ideal to bring chocolate innovation to a boring and staid British chocolate market.

feeds.title: Guppy's Chocolates Blog
feeds.description: Guppy's Chocolates are Peter and Fran Guppy and we are passionate about all things chocolate! We are a family-run business, committed to providing good quality chocolates at reasonable prices. Find out about new products, stories, and interesting snippets regarding the world of chocolate.

feeds.title: Paccari Chocolate UK
feeds.description: Pacari is a family-owned Ecuadorian company with a simple mission: to produce the highest quality organic dark chocolate in the world in the most ethical and sustainable way possible.
